mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing new windows for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing new windows, consider the climate zone, your budget, desired energy efficiency, noise reduction needs, and aesthetic preferences. Window material (vinyl, wood, aluminum, fiberglass), glazing type (double, triple-pane), and special coatings (Low-E) all play a role. A key decision factor is the U-factor and Solar Heat Gain Coefficient (SHGC) ratings, which indicate insulation value and how well windows block solar heat. Higher insulation values are beneficial in areas with varied temperatures, such as Dublin, to maintain indoor comfort year-round.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider climate, budget, energy efficiency, noise reduction, and aesthetics. Key decision factors include window material, glazing type, coatings, and performance ratings like U-factor and SHGC.
